name: document_search
description: Searches and retrieves relevant text passages and snippets from local documents in the documents/ folder. Call this tool whenever the user asks questions about company policies, internal handbooks, local notes, or documentation.

query.description: The search keywords or question topic to look up inside local documents (e.g. 'leave policy', 'hardware allowance', 'ReAct framework').

filename.description: Optional specific file to search in (e.g. 'company_handbook.txt', 'ai_notes.md'). If not provided, searches all local documents.
